The bark of Cael’fii begins to wither thanks to the shards of cold iron, but after a few moments, the wooden gunsmith exclaims and clambers up the sheer surface of Cael’fii on all fours, moving far more fluidly than seems possible. They reach the crown of the tree and whisper a short series of words in sylvan that sound like half-request, half-prayer. They press the device up against the trunk and it melds into the surface of the bark as though being dropped into oil. There is a thunderous shake before a bright burst of purple-green light radiates out from the gentle mother. For a moment, the entire burrough is shrouded in a calm light that can be seen throughout the city. Then there is a snapping sound and a large rush of wind as simultaneously, all pure iron in the burrough is transformed into a composite or another metal entirely (the function of player tools and weapons will not be affected). At first the redcoats seem confused, before the fey denizens of the burrough swarm over them. They are getting hurt and burned, but they are able to fight much better. Within a matter of minutes the redcoats are driven back, suffering heavy losses. Ferrytown is safe.

However, as the purple light dissipates it passes over the other burroughs, affecting their metals to some extent as well. What implications this may have for Empire CIty is as of yet unknown.

ok so here's the pitch. first off katie and i want to go out in an epic blaze of glory and shift our characters afterwards, at the least the racial aspects. a key part of the plan involves a romantic version of mutually assured destruction 😏
so i got an item to propose, well two to be precise... hehe here it is:

-We need 2x "Rings of Tragic Betrothal" (proposed homebrew item for DM approval)
- The 2 items are paired for 2 players, respectively, who are betrothed.
- Has same properties of "Ring of Loyalty": If you are reduced to zero hit points while attuned to a band of loyalty, you instantly die.
- Has an additional property that ensures the first effect triggers for both wearers simultaneously: The two characters are vitally linked, if one would drop below 0 hitpoints, the other will take the damage instead. If the damage meets or exceeds the total combined HP, both characters will die instantly. The rings can not be removed from their bodies once attuned.
In the event that the ring would drop a character to 1 and the other to 0 then they manage to each have 1 HP an stay standing for the moment. (very rare occurrence, but actually possible on an odd damage amount that is one less than the combined HPs of the two characters)
I think that's about it, unless a DM wants to riff on this and add properties, either additional downsides or perks. season to taste
